description:
Returns a paginated list of the customers of this company, with optional filters.
Only the customers of the company in the path are returned.

Endpoint: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/customers

CustomerSortBy.description:
Customer field the list is ordered by. Ties are broken by customer id, so pages are
stable.

- `legal_name`: legal name.
- `nif`: tax identifier.
- `email`: email address.
- `phone`: phone number.
- `city`: city of the address.
- `province`: province of the address.
- `active`: whether the customer is active.
- `created_at`: creation instant.

SortOrder.description:
Sort direction. Shared vocabulary for every `sort_order` query param: declared once so the
generator emits a real enum and an unknown direction is rejected with `400` instead of being
silently ignored.

active.description:
Filter by active/inactive status. Defaults to `true`, so inactive customers must be
requested explicitly with `active=false`. Deleted customers are never returned by
either value.

company_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the company the operation acts on — its identifier, not its NIF. It is the only source of context: the account that owns it is derived from it, and the `BeeL-Active-Company` header plays no part. A company you do not reach answers `403`, and so does a company that does not exist, so the existence of a company in another account is never disclosed.

legal_name.description: Filter by legal name (partial search case-insensitive)

limit.description: How many items to return per page. The response echoes it back as `pagination.items_per_page`.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The response echoes it back as `pagination.current_page`.

search.description: Global search by name, NIF or email

sort_by.description: Field to sort by. Results are always tie-broken by a stable internal key, so paging through the collection never repeats or skips a customer.

name: beel_list_customers
